title: Ask for Late Checkout
wrap_friend: 你剛剛完成了一段 A2 住宿服務情境，說明需求、聽懂回覆，並確認下一步。
learner_goal: Ask if late checkout is possible and confirm the allowed time.
register_notes: Broad everyday English hotel-service register; polite, short A2 responses; no complaint escalation.
support_text: Ask if late checkout is possible and confirm the final checkout time.

choices.surface: Can I check out a little later?
choices.speak: Can I check out a little later?

choices.surface: Can I check in a little later?
choices.speak: Can I check in a little later?

choices.feedback: Price negotiation is outside this A2 task.

turns.speaker: npc
turns.surface: Today, you can check out by one o’clock.
turns.speak: Today, you can check out by one o’clock.

inline_explain.title: A2 pattern
inline_explain.explain: A useful pattern for this accommodation situation.

choices.surface: I will book a new room.
choices.speak: I will book a new room.
choices.feedback: This is checkout time confirmation, not a new booking.

turns.speaker: npc
turns.surface: Please show your room card at the desk before noon.
turns.speak: Please show your room card at the desk before noon.
turns.translation: 請在中午前把房卡拿到櫃台。

choices.surface: I show my card before noon, right?
choices.translation: 中午前拿房卡給您看，對嗎？
choices.speak: I show my card before noon, right?

choices.surface: I tell you my passport number, right?
choices.speak: I tell you my passport number, right?
choices.feedback: Passport details are not needed here.

choices.surface: I pick up my luggage at seven, right?
choices.speak: I pick up my luggage at seven, right?
choices.feedback: This is checkout, not luggage pickup.

turns.speaker: npc
turns.surface: Okay, I will mark checkout for one o’clock.
turns.speak: Okay, I will mark checkout for one o’clock.
turns.translation: 好的，我幫您確認一點退房。

choices.surface: Thank you. I will check out at one.
choices.speak: Thank you. I will check out at one.

choices.surface: I will ask for a refund.
choices.speak: I will ask for a refund.

choices.surface: I will take the train tomorrow morning.
choices.speak: I will take the train tomorrow morning.
choices.feedback: This is checkout confirmation, not transport.

feedback: Distractors test wrong time, place, service domain, or out-of-scope escalation while preserving A2 boundaries.
tts_segments: Today, you can check out by one o’clock.
Please show your room card at the desk before noon.
Okay, I will mark checkout for one o’clock.
runtime_notes: EN A2 accommodation candidate. Full-walk runtime gate required before final closeout.

notes.authoring_policy: Fresh-authored from the neutral A2 accommodation brief. KO surfaces were not translated.
notes.a2_boundary: Low-risk accommodation/service task; avoids compensation, emergency, legal, medical, police, immigration, banking, insurance, or identity-sensitive handling.
